name: 000-baseline
change: none: defaults at 79571fb
why: starting point of the 2026-09-30 agent-driven pass

name: 001-baseline-instr
change: instrument: Stats.Death (killer rank, adjacent, awake, potions left), bot report and rows carry it
why: deaths need a cause before a knob moves: pack attrition vs burst vs resource exhaustion

name: 003-bot-escape2
change: bot: losing() leaves by portal at <50% life with an empty belt or <40% with one potion, while any threat is in view (was <35% and empty belt)
why: deaths came at 0 potions with 3-4 adjacent: the old call came too late for a two-turn portal exit; a first version that also fled at <50% with 3 adjacent while potions remained was worse (fighter king 62->35%, run 002) because a potion beats two exposed turns; this version: fighter king 62->71%, deepest +0.27, caster unchanged, not sure at 48 seeds but the bot now uses scrolls the way a player does

name: 007-bot-nook-hp
change: bot: hp() counts only the next turn's potion drain, not the whole pool; retreat() backs into a nook with fewer open sides (caves have no corridors), tried when the current cell has more than 3 open sides
why: trace of fighter seed 3: called 17 real life '38%' because 90 sat in the pool, read a portal and died on the spot; fought a six-spider pack in the open. Effect within noise (score 20.56 -> 21.10, fighter king +0.04, caster -0.06), kept as correctness of the player model

name: 008-base-packlive
change: goals: packLive (live over pack size x speed, 8-12) and fight (packLive over turns to clear the pack, 1-2) scored; live (24-36) reported at weight 0
why: live vs one normal sat in band at grotto1 (27-32) while 45 of 96 runs died there: the typical grotto pack is 3-5 spiders at speed 130 (5.2 attacks a turn) against 2-3.5 elsewhere; the band's own rationale ('a pack of three lands in 8-12') is the pack-aware number. New baseline under these goals; score not comparable with #1-#4

name: 009-spider
change: code: Grotto Spider pack 3-5 -> 2-4, speed 130 -> 120 (monsters.go)
why: the typical grotto pack dealt 5.2 attacks a turn against 2-3.5 in every other area; packLive.grotto1 5.7/5.2 -> 8.9/8.3 (fighter/caster, band 8-12) and fight.grotto1 0.49/0.34 -> 1.03/0.71 as predicted; score 23.69 -> 22.61, within noise; arrivals at grotto3 still 0-1: the remaining grotto killers are champion packs (spider, ghoul, golem champions 25 of 56 grotto deaths) and the caster going dry

name: 010-spider-champ2
change: rules: ChampPerDepth 3 -> 2 on top of #6
why: champion packs 29% -> 22% at grotto1; score 21.89 vs 22.61, fighter grotto3 1, caster grotto1 30 vs 32: nothing moved beyond noise and champion XP/loot is the fighter's progression engine (run 004 at 1.5 was worse); try weaker champions instead of fewer

name: 017-manalvl4
change: rules: ManaPerLvl 2 -> 4
why: caster grotto3 1 -> 5, abyss1 2, score 20.29 -> 16.70 at 96 seeds, but fighter king 0.68 -> 0.55 sure (12 up/24 down paired): the fighter spends the bigger pool on ranged bolts that pull whole packs; a shared hero stat is the wrong lever for a caster problem

name: 018-boltcurve
change: rules: BoltEnePow 1 -> 1.2, BoltMul 1 -> 0.75
why: flattens the caster's damage curve (same early, +30% at grotto, +45% deep); caster grotto3 1 -> 8, score 20.29 -> 19.05 (noise), fighter king 0.68 -> 0.54 again: the fighter's own bolt got weaker (7.6-12 vs 8-13) and it still pulls with it; revisit once the fighter stops bolt-pulling

name: 019-mana-curve
change: rules: ManaPerLvl 4 + BoltEnePow 1.2 + BoltMul 0.75
why: score 21.75 vs 20.29: the two caster levers do not add; fighter king 0.53

name: 021-base96-nopull
change: bot: fighter bolts only awake targets (no bolt-pulling sleepers)
why: hypothesis for the fighter's loss under more mana (#12): bolts wake whole camps. Fighter king 0.68 -> 0.62 (noise, 13 up/18 down), score 20.29 -> 21.78; no predicted effect, so the simpler bot stays

name: 022-manaene
change: rules: ManaPerEne 1.2 -> 1.7 (new knob; MaxMP = 14 + ManaPerEne*ENE + ManaPerLvl*(lvl-1))
why: the caster's kills per mana pool fell from 3 at crypt1 to 1.7 at grotto1 (bolt cost grows with level, pool grows with Energy and level, monster life grows quadratically), so it spent 18-34 town trips a run on potions and died walking home dry. Energy-scaled mana reaches only the caster (fighter Ene 15: +12%). Paired at 96 seeds: caster trips -3.8 (sure), surplus/lvl +240 (sure), deepest +0.29, clvl +0.57, grotto3 1 -> 4; fighter unchanged; score 21.78 -> 19.75

name: 025-income
change: rules: QuestGoldPerLvl 250 -> 100, GoldPerLvl 3 -> 2
why: income was 35-40% sells, 20-25% quest, 30% drops; surplus after consumables was 6.4/5.0 gambles a level (band 0.8-1.5). Paired at 96 seeds: score 20.46 -> 17.35 (-3.11, -5.42..+0.07), fighter.gold 6.4 -> 4.7, caster.gold 5.0 -> 3.0, gap 0.21 -> 0.15, fighter king 0.61 -> 0.67; combat measures unchanged: the bot buys less shop gear and dies no sooner

name: 024-champ-weaker
change: rules: ChampHp 2.2 -> 1.8, ChampDmg 1.3 -> 1.2 on #14
why: champions kill the fighter in the grotto, but weaker champions help the caster (king 0.82 -> 0.91, grotto1 69 -> 82) and not the fighter (0.61 -> 0.57): gap 0.21 -> 0.33, score +2.39; the fighter's grotto problem is elsewhere

name: 026-boltcurve
change: rules: BoltEnePow 1.2, BoltMul 0.75 on #14
why: meant to flatten the caster's curve (same at crypt2, stronger deep) but it is a buff from crypt4 on (kills.crypt4 2.5 -> 2.0): caster king 0.92, oracle 3, gap 0.33, score +1.80; the caster is already the stronger build

name: 027-income-sell
change: rules: #15 income cut + SellDiv 12 -> 24 (new knob)
why: gold bands nearly met (2.9/1.4) but 3 runs stuck (hard fail) and the fighter weaker (king 0.55, grotto1 38): sells are the fighter's gear budget; look at the stuck runs before trying a smaller cut

name: 029-monarmor
change: rules: MonArmorK 120 -> 200 on #15
why: monster armor only reduces melee, so a fighter-only lever; fighter king 0.67 -> 0.67, deepest +0.03: no effect at 96 seeds

name: 030-tohit
change: rules: ToHitPerLvl 0 -> 1 on #15
why: melee-only to-hit; fighter king 0.67 -> 0.53 (15 up/28 down, borderline sure), no other measure moved: at best nothing, likely one false 'sure' in thirty comparisons

name: 031-base-stall
change: bot: a level counts as explored after 40 turns without a new cell
why: meant for auto-explore shuttling between frontier cells whose unseen neighbours can never be lit (3 stuck runs in #17, all in the marsh with the grotto mouth seen and reachable); the rule also fired during long fights and errands: 34-36 stuck runs of 96, hard fail

name: 034-base-stale
change: bot: explored after 40 consecutive auto-explore steps without a new cell
why: second try at the shuttle; walking back across an explored 150x90 level to a far frontier is longer than 40 steps: 35-39 stuck, hard fail

name: 035-base-spent
change: code: auto-explore marks the cell it stands on as spent when unseen neighbours stay unseen from there and never targets it again (game.go autoStep, Level.Spent)
why: the shuttle fixed where it lives, for the o key too; bit-identical results on the 96 base seeds (score 17.35, no seed differs); the stuck seeds of #17 and #19 are re-run as #22 and #23

name: 037-strdiv
change: rules: StrDiv 60 -> 45 (melee multiplier 1 + STR/45)
why: the fighter's only build-specific lever besides melee to-hit and monster armor (both tried, no effect): +15% melee at crypt4, +17% at grotto1, +6% for a caster that rarely swings. Paired at 96 seeds: fighter king 0.67 -> 0.72 (21 up/16 down), clvl +0.57, deepest +0.24, caster unchanged, gap 0.15 -> 0.09; score +0.62 (noise) because fighter.kills.crypt4 2.94 -> 2.59 drops under the 3-5 band. The build gap was the target; kept

name: 036-income-sell
change: rules: #16 again with the explore fix (income cut + SellDiv 24)
why: identical numbers to #16 and still 3 stuck runs: the stuck runs were not the frontier shuttle; traced next. Even scored, the cut costs power: caster deepest -0.58 and clvl -1.06 (sure), fighter king 0.67 -> 0.57; sells are the gear budget. Try pricing the sinks instead of cutting income

name: 040-dmgshape
change: rules: DmgQuad 0.02 -> 0.015, DmgLin 0.24 -> 0.26 on #24
why: flatter deep damage (-5% at grotto1, -13% at abyss2, +2% at crypt2): nothing moved (fighter king 6 up/6 down), score +0.64; the grotto wall is not a 5-10% number

name: 041-hpshape
change: rules: HpQuad 0.05 -> 0.04, HpLin 0.32 -> 0.35 on #24
why: flatter deep life: fighter king 0.72 -> 0.64, deepest -0.33, gap 0.09 -> 0.20, score +0.98; more early life for monsters costs the fighter, less deep life buys nothing measurable

name: 039-sinks
change: rules: SellDiv 12 -> 16, GamblePrice 120 -> 200, GamblePerDepth 30 -> 50, RerollPrice 50 -> 100, RerollPerDepth 10 -> 20 on #24
why: gold bands 4.91/3.06 -> 2.35/1.32 and score 17.97 -> 15.90 (-2.08, -6.30..+0.61), but clvl -0.47/-0.71 sure and deepest -0.24/-0.30: the sell cut takes gear off the hero; retried as sink prices alone (#28) and with SellDiv 14 (#29)

name: 042-base
change: bot: a frontier goal, once chosen, is kept until reached or spent (explore); Level.Spent set on every cell the hero stands on
why: fixes the marsh flip-flop of #22/#23 (caster seed 26 now reaches grotto1) but 3 fighter runs stuck: with dead frontier cells gone, auto-explore spends 300+ turns sweeping loot on a cleared level, and the stall rule counts only new cells, kills and level changes; fixed in #33 by counting pickups and the walk to the stairs

name: 043-sinks-only
change: rules: GamblePrice 200, GamblePerDepth 50, RerollPrice 100, RerollPerDepth 20 on #24 (no sell cut)
why: fighter king 0.73 -> 0.64 and clvl -0.43, both sure, caster unchanged: gambling is the fighter's gear pipeline (it gambles the surplus, the caster buys potions); a dearer sink starves it. The gold band (0.8-1.5 gambles a level) conflicts with the fighter's progression under these rules

name: 044-sinks-sell14
change: rules: #28 plus SellDiv 14
why: fighter deepest -0.46, clvl -0.86, king -0.15, all sure; caster surplus -183 sure: same mechanism, worse

name: 046-potion-champ
change: rules: PotionHeal 0.65 + ChampHp 1.8 on #24
why: caster deepest +0.66, clvl +1.21, king 0.92 (sure), grotto3 8; fighter king 0.68 (-0.05): champions are what the fighter farms; weaker ones widen the gap to 0.24. Potions alone (#31) keep the caster's gain without it

name: 047-base
change: bot: gold and pack changes count as progress; the walk to known stairs counts as progress (stall rule)
why: with dead frontier cells spent, auto-explore sweeps loot across a cleared level for 300+ turns and then walks to the stairs; neither counted as progress and 3 fighter runs of #27 were called stuck mid-sweep. 0 stuck of 192 on seeds 1-96; fighter king 0.75, caster 0.84; score 16.66, the best scored on seeds 1-96

name: 048-final
change: rules: PotionHeal 0.5 -> 0.65
why: the sampler bands see no potions, deaths do: median potions left at death is 0 for both builds. Paired at 96 seeds on #33: caster deepest +0.29 (sure), clvl +0.39, potions per level -0.43/-1.05 (sure), fighter unchanged (king 0.75 -> 0.74); score +1.35 (noise) from the gold band, as fewer potions bought means more surplus. Kept for the caster's progress and fewer town trips; validated on fresh seeds in #36

name: 049-val-defaults
change: validation: DefaultRules on fresh seeds 1001-1096, current code and bot
why: the control for the pick; not comparable in score with seeds 1-96

name: 050-val-final
change: validation: the pick (ManaPerEne 1.7, QuestGoldPerLvl 100, GoldPerLvl 2, StrDiv 45, PotionHeal 0.65) on fresh seeds 1001-1096
why: vs #35 paired: fighter deepest +0.57, clvl +1.06 (sure), king 0.67 -> 0.72, grotto3 0 -> 4, Oracle 1; caster deepest +0.62, clvl +1.03 (sure), king 0.79 -> 0.89, grotto3 2 -> 7, trips -2.2 (sure); gold bands 5.8/4.0 -> 5.1/3.2. 3 stuck runs of 192 make it a hard fail by the letter; traced separately

name: 051-final
change: bot: drink only when the heal pool has room (the game refuses a drink past full life without a turn)
why: hp() (#4) counts one turn of drain, so at 49% life with a full pool the bot asked for a potion every call and never took a turn: 2 of the 3 stuck runs of #36. Bit-identical on seeds 1-96 (score 18.01, no seed differs)

name: 053-val-defaults
change: validation control: DefaultRules, final code and bot, seeds 1001-1096
why: the pair for #39

name: 052-val-final
change: validation: the pick on seeds 1001-1096 with the final bot (ManaPerEne 1.7, QuestGoldPerLvl 100, GoldPerLvl 2, StrDiv 45, PotionHeal 0.65)
why: vs #38 paired: score 19.62 -> 14.52 (-5.09, -7.62..-1.44, sure); fighter deepest +0.57, clvl +1.06 (sure), king 0.67 -> 0.72, grotto3 0 -> 4, Oracle 1; caster deepest +0.62, clvl +1.04 (sure), king 0.79 -> 0.89, grotto3 2 -> 7, trips -2.2 (sure), surplus -199 (sure); 2 stuck of 192. The recommended configuration

name: 055-review-fixes
change: code review follow-ups: Level.Spent dropped (dead: neighbours are always seen; its only effect was the bot's permanent 'no way there' mark), frontier skips go in b.skip (cleared when more is seen), descend() resets the stall clock only on a known path, hurtPlayer ignores blows after death, hp() shares drainStep, retreat() dead clause gone
why: seeds 1-96 vs #39's base: 1-3 seeds differ per build, score 18.01 -> 18.02 (-0.13..+0.41); 0 stuck

name: 056-review-fixes-val
change: same fixes on seeds 1001-1096
why: vs #40 paired: score 14.52 -> 14.81 (-0.25..+0.88), the two runs that were stuck (fighter 1051, caster 1060) now die instead; 0 stuck of 192: the residual ~1% stuck class was the permanent frontier mark
